item.title: Star gymnast earns a spot in the record book on the vault
item.description: In the first meet of the 2025-26 season, senior Grace Murray engraved her name into Ithaca College gymnastics history, tying the program record vault score with a 9.800 score Jan. 10 against SUNY Brockport. Murray added her name in the record book next to Carolyn Nichols ’19, who surpassed the previous mark in 2018. item.title: Comfort Food Trail brings warmth to The Commons during frosty January
item.description: When Denise O’Leary ’17 thinks of comfort food, she pictures a warm and nostalgic bowl of tomato soup. As head chef and co-owner of Cafe DeWitt, O’Leary is uniquely situated to share this experience with the world, one locally sourced meal at a time. In January, as temperatures slip lower and lower, restaurants like Cafe DeWitt struggle to find customers. item.title: Editorial: Political rage is meaningless unless followed by realistic action
item.description: There is much to be angry about within this country, and that anger being expressed is a logical path. But while language is powerful, words can only do so much. Some may believe that rejecting and disengaging with the whole system demonstrates superior morality, but in reality, it shows their lazy inability to reasonably and realistically interact with a system to try to change it for the better. item.title: ‘No Other Choice’ leaves audiences dying (of laughter)
item.description: Sacked. Dumped. Terminated. Axed. These are not just violent euphemisms for getting fired: they are also vivid descriptions of Park Chan-wook’s latest film, “No Other Choice.” Following its limited U.S. release Dec. 25, Park’s highly anticipated dark comedy soon became an incredible success in South Korea and overseas — as well as a favorite in the awards circuit. item.title: Hundreds in Ithaca rally against ICE after Minneapolis crackdown
item.description: Hundreds of protesters came together in single-digit degree weather at 4 p.m. Jan. 30 on The Commons to rally against U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement’s violence. The rally was part of a national day of protest against ICE following the killings of Renee Good and Alex Pretti in Minneapolis. item.title: Gymnastics claims first in a tri-match against Rhode Island and Springfield College
item.description: Ithaca College gymnastics placed first in a tri-meet against the Rhode Island College Anchormen and the Springfield College Pride on Feb. 1 in the Ben Light Gymnasium. The Bombers emerged on top with 189.575, the Anchormen settled in second at 187.900 and the Pride fell to the bottom of the podium with 186.800.
